name: agent-transcript
line: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and Copilot session files as plain text, each turn numbered, so you can ask what an agent was told.

name: agents-md-check
line: Commands and paths named in AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md that no longer exist in the repo.

name: almanac
line: An Almanac's catalog.json (climate, health, civic and the rest): each public dataset's description and source as passages, with when its link was last checked.

name: archivebox
line: ArchiveBox snapshots: each saved page's text, with its URL and the date it was captured.

name: bank
line: Bank CSV and OFX statements as dated lines, with spending by month.

name: basic-memory
line: Basic Memory's Markdown notes where an AI wrote them: each observation and relation handed in through propose, waiting for your seal.

name: bluesky
line: A Bluesky repo.car export: your posts as dated lines, read by a small CAR and CBOR reader of its own.

name: bookmarks
line: Browser bookmarks (HTML export, Firefox JSON) and history, read from a copy of its SQLite file.

name: browse
line: A local web page to ask questions and approve answers, reachable from this machine only.

name: care
line: For caregivers: medications, vitals and appointments from a care log, what's due and what moved.

name: changed
line: What's new, edited or deleted in your folder since the last check, as fingerprint rows.

name: claude
line: Suggestions from Claude through the Anthropic API, citing your passages.

name: codebase-memory
line: codebase-memory-mcp's code graph, read from a copy of its SQLite file: each function, what calls it, and its file and line.

name: corpus-lens
line: corpus-lens's process reports on your own sessions with agents, as passages: where your intent arrives, who writes the code.

name: dice
line: Seeded dice rolls as rows: every roll replayable and checkable.

name: dice5e
line: Full tabletop dice notation (4d6kh3, advantage).

name: digest
line: One page: suggestions waiting, approvals gone stale, dates coming up, questions repeated.

name: discord
line: Discord's data package: your messages, one dated line each, by server and channel.

name: encrypt
line: Keeps the record folder encrypted at rest.

name: flashcards
line: Approved question-and-answer pairs become cards, scheduled by spaced repetition.

name: forecasts
line: Write a prediction before the outcome, settle it later, see your Brier score.

name: git-history
line: Commit messages and diffs as a dated pile: "when did we change the retry limit?"
needs: the git program; GPL, called not linked

name: health
line: Apple Health and Google Fit exports as daily numbers the readings add-on can trend.

name: hermes
line: Hermes Agent asking your folder as a plugin, and its memories, and what its dreaming plugin consolidates, handed in through propose.

name: homestead
line: Homestead's exports from its law, ledger and health modules: records, deadlines and evidence as dated passages.

name: instapaper
line: Instapaper's CSV and HTML export: saved articles and highlights as dated lines.

name: invoices
line: For freelancers: invoices and payments matched by the id pattern you give, never guessed.

name: jeles
line: Your approved answers as Jeles nuggets, with question, answer, sources and who sealed it, and Jeles' own verified nuggets read back as passages.

name: joplin
line: Joplin's .jex export, read without unpacking it: each note as plain text with its title and dates.

name: journiv
line: Journiv journal entries, with their moods, as dated lines, once its export format is settled.

name: jrnl
line: jrnl journals: each [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM] entry as a dated passage.

name: karakeep
line: Karakeep's JSON export: bookmarks, notes and tags as plain text.

name: lessons
line: Lesson plans from the Emerging Rule community library, by grade and subject, as passages a teacher can ask.

name: life
line: Conway's Game of Life as rows: a fully deterministic world on the record.

name: line-origin
line: Which agent session wrote this line of code: git blame to the commit, then the transcript turn that made it.
needs: the git program; GPL, called not linked

name: local-model
line: Suggestions from a model on this machine only, such as Ollama or llama.cpp.
needs: a local model server; licence varies by model

name: mastodon
line: A Mastodon or Pixelfed account archive's outbox.json: your posts as dated lines.

name: meaning
line: Search by meaning: "who owes me money" finds "invoice outstanding".
network: the model, downloaded once from Hugging Face

name: memory-import
line: An AI assistant's memory store, SQLite or Markdown, handed in through propose: one suggestion per memory, none trusted until you seal it.

name: mex
line: mex's project memory for coding agents: its scaffold read as cited passages, and what an agent writes back held for your seal.

name: nestor
line: Answers Nestor records a person has checked, read from a copy of its SQLite store, each citing who checked it and when.

name: oakenscroll
line: Oakenscroll's Office calibration ledger: what you believed, how hard, and how it resolved, as dated passages.

name: ocr
line: Text out of photos of letters and scanned PDFs.
needs: pytesseract and the tesseract program; Apache-2.0

name: pgp
line: Signs exports and reports with your PGP key, verifiable anywhere.
needs: the gpg program and python-gnupg; BSD

name: photos
line: When and where each photo was taken, as dated lines.

name: pocket
line: Pocket's export, the HTML and CSV in its zip, as one dated line per saved article, now that Pocket is gone.

name: quiet-corner
line: A Quiet Corner backup file: a teacher's classroom observations as dated passages, for that teacher's questions alone.

name: reconciler
line: willow-reconciler run on this repo's idea list and git history: how much of what was proposed has landed.

name: redential
line: The bundle redential-cli's scan makes, written to the record before you submit it, so what left your machine can be checked later.
needs: the redential program, run through npx; Apache-2.0

name: report
line: A self-checking bundle: the record, the approved answers, and a script that re-verifies them on any machine.

name: safe-app
line: willow as a SAFE app: installed from the SAFE App Store, authorized per session, and deleted clean.

name: sap-gate
line: The mcp add-on's tool calls checked against SAP/1.0 grants before they run, through openclaw-sap-gate.

name: secrets-audit
line: Finds keys and passwords sitting in plain files.

name: session-cost
line: Tokens each agent session spent, by day and by repo, summed from its own session files and priced from a table you keep.

name: sheets
line: Spreadsheets with formulas and formatting kept, beyond what the office add-on reads.

name: sigmap
line: SigMap's signature map of a codebase as plain text: each function's signature with its file and line, for questions about the code.

name: signal
line: A Signal backup, decrypted with its passphrase, as one dated line per message.

name: slack
line: Slack's export zip: one dated line per message, with channel and author.

name: speak
line: Reads answers aloud.

name: stems
line: Word forms for 20+ languages, so "maisons" finds "maison".

name: subtitles
line: Subtitle and transcript files (.vtt, .srt) as lines cited by timestamp, for podcasts and videos already transcribed.

name: synonyms
line: Suggests words-list lines for a word no file has.

name: takeout
line: Google Takeout's My Activity and YouTube history, JSON or HTML, as dated lines.

name: transcript-redact
line: An agent transcript with keys, home paths and emails taken out before you share it, each removal listed by line.

name: typos
line: Forgives misspellings in questions.

name: voice
line: Dictation, calls and lectures transcribed into dated text.

name: wallabag
line: wallabag's JSON or HTML export: saved entries as plain text, with their tags.

name: words-de
line: German common words, so questions aren't matched on "der" and "und".

name: words-es
line: Spanish common words ("el", "y").

name: words-fr
line: French common words ("le", "et").

name: words-pt
line: Portuguese common words ("o", "e").

name: writefreely
line: WriteFreely posts, from its export or a copy of its SQLite database, as dated text.
